input.quote: (b) Each Party's names, trademarks and logos are the exclusive property of said respective Party, and neither Party will acquire any proprietary rights therein by reason of this Agreement or any other agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no intellectual property or ownership article. The only proprietary-rights language is Section 14(b) (names, trademarks and logos) and the Customer warranty at 9(c)(i) that it owns the Content and Properties; neither is a usable ownership provision. Nothing states that we retain all rights in our Content, Properties and the Requests/visitor data flowing to Kubient (p0011, p0035), nothing addresses ownership of the "deliverables" and "products delivered hereunder" referenced in Kubient's warranties (p0033, p0040), and there is no bar on joint ownership. On the plus side, nothing assigns our IP or data to Kubient, so this is not walk-away territory; but with no clause at all the rule is unmet, and for a critical ip-data rule we have inserted a short ownership section (Customer retains Content/Properties/Customer Data, Kubient assigns Customer-specific deliverables, Kubient keeps the Auction Platform and background tools subject to a perpetual licence-back, no joint ownership), with the fallback licence offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add an intellectual property / Customer Data ownership section (Customer retains Content, Properties and Customer Data; Kubient assigns deliverables; Kubient keeps platform IP subject to a perpetual licence-back; no joint ownership).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no ownership provision, so we have added one confirming that we retain all rights in our Content, Properties and Customer Data, that Kubient assigns the deliverables it creates for us, and that Kubient keeps its Auction Platform and background tools subject to a perpetual licence for anything embedded in those deliverables. If Kubient cannot assign, our fallback is Kubient ownership of its generic tools plus the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify deliverables.

ops.text: 13A. Intellectual Property; Customer Data. (a) As between the Parties, Customer exclusively owns and retains all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Content, the Properties, the Requests and all other data, information and materials provided or made available by Customer or collected from the Properties or Customer's users or visitors (collectively, "Customer Data"). Kubient acquires no right, title or interest in the Content, the Properties or Customer Data other than the limited right to use the same solely to provide the Services during the Term, and Kubient shall not sell, license or otherwise disclose Customer Data to any third party except as reasonably necessary to provide the Services. (b) Customer exclusively owns, and Kubient hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer, all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to any deliverables, reports and other work product created by Kubient specifically for Customer under this Agreement or any Exhibit. (c) Kubient retains all right, title and interest in the Auction Platform and in Kubient's pre-existing and generally applicable technology, tools and know-how, and grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any such materials that are embedded in or necessary to use the deliverables for Customer's business purposes. (d) Nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of either Party's intellectual property.
